subject: Annual assurance: staffing model vs fixed-fee proposal (SecureGate)
messages:
From: Alex Holmes <alex.holmes@securegate.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: sales@securegate.com
Date: 2026-08-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SecureGate proposal for annual pen + 2 red team cycles

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the time last week. Attached is SecureGate's updated proposal (v3) for Redwood's annual assurance engagement: one full-stack penetration test (app + infra) and two targeted red team exercises over a 12-month window. We've sketched two commercial models in the attachment: (1) a fixed-fee annual package and (2) a blended staffing model billed on a per-engagement time-and-materials basis with monthly retainer credits.

Key high-level bullets from the attachment:
- Deliverables: exec summary, technical report, remediation validation (3 months), replayable test evidence (redacted), and a 90-minute walkthrough per engagement.
- Scheduling: preferred windows in Q4 and Q2; flexible for canary releases.
- Evidence handling: SFTP transfer + encrypted bundle, or direct sharing to your secure Drive folder on request.
- Compliance: we provide SOC2-friendly artifacts and tester background checks on request; we can sign your custom NDA.

Two pricing notes for Redwood to consider:
- Fixed-fee (one price): fewer administrative overheads; we include a contingency for up to 20% extra effort.
- Staffing model: itemized rates per role (lead tester, senior pentester, junior analyst), clearer transparency but variable final invoice depending on scope creep.

I've also included a draft SOW docx in the attachments with role-level CVs redacted. If you'd like, we can convert the fixed-fee into milestone invoices tied to each deliverable for easier procurement.

Next step: let me know which commercial model you'd like us to firm up and any specific evidence/transfer requirements. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call this week.

Best,
Alex Holmes
Commercial Lead, SecureGate
attachments: securegate-proposal-v3.pdf, sow-draft-2026.docx

Alex —

Thanks for sending this over. A couple of clarifying asks before we route this to procurement:

1) On the staffing model: can you show a sample staffing plan for a single red team exercise (roles, estimated hours, and deliverables per role)? We want to compare line-item variance vs the fixed-fee contingency.

2) Fixed-fee detail: does the contingency cover additional follow-up verification (post-remediation validation), or is that explicitly billed out? If included, please call out limits (e.g., number of validation attempts).

3) Evidence transfer: Redwood requires encrypted transfers into our secure Drive or a short-lived S3 presigned link; can you commit to those options and confirm retention windows for your temporary storage?

4) SOW terms: we have a standard clause about data retention and asset return — are you comfortable with a 90-day evidence retention on your side and immediate deletion post-transfer?

If you can respond inline in the SOW docx and send a redline, that will speed review. I'll loop in Finance/Procurement once we have the commercial model clarified.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Trust Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Priya —

Appreciate the detailed notes — answers inline below and I've uploaded an annotated SOW (sow-draft-2026.docx) to the Drive link you shared. Highlights: 

1) Sample staffing: for a 5-day red team we propose: 1 Lead (30 hrs), 2 Senior Pentesters (2 x 40 hrs), 1 Analyst (24 hrs) — deliverables include TTP map, prioritized findings, replayable evidence package, and a 90-minute remediation sync. We've added a sample timesheet appendix to the SOW so you can see typical effort per task.

2) Fixed-fee contingency: fixed-fee includes up to 2 rounds of remediation validation (each validation window up to 8 hours of tester time). Additional validation beyond that is billed at our senior pentester rate. We also offer a fixed-fee add-on for extended validation if you'd prefer to cap exposure.

3) Evidence transfer: we commit to S3 presigned links with automatic expiry (default 7 days) or encrypted upload to your Drive (we'll coordinate a service account). We will not retain evidence beyond 30 days after the final transfer unless you request longer retention in writing. That retention period is configurable; 90 days is fine with an updated clause in the SOW.

4) SOW terms: fine to accept the 90-day deletion/return requirement; we'll add a clause requiring written approval for any longer retention and an audit log of access.

I've also included optional pricing permutations in the SOW: milestone invoicing for fixed-fee, and a monthly retainer credit model for staffing. If you want, we can issue a DocuSign package for the fixed-fee SOW and include milestone invoices aligned to delivery.

DocuSign preview: https://app.docusign.com/frames/signer?d=5f8a1b2c
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Csecuregate-proposals

Let me know if you'd like us to lock the fixed-fee and send a DocuSign for procurement.

Best,
Alex

Alex — quick internal decision: procurement prefers a fixed-fee for predictability year-over-year, but Security wants the optional extended validation add-on included as a priced line item rather than ad-hoc billing. Finance asked that milestones align to reports (post-test exec summary, full report + evidence transfer, final remediation validation).

Next steps from our side:
- Marissa will attach the procurement PO template and confirm milestone invoice cadence. (Marissa: please share PO by EOD Mon.)
- Dev will confirm the service account details for encrypted Drive upload and any required IAM permissions.
- Priya (me) will review your redlines in the SOW and route to Legal if any non-standard clauses remain.

If SecureGate can issue the DocuSign for the fixed-fee with the optional validation add-on as a priced addendum, we can fast-track to signature. Please copy procurements@redwood.com on the DocuSign envelope.
